description:
Perform a security audit of the 'ConfidentialBoardRoom' meeting. 

1. Join the meeting 'ConfidentialBoardRoom' (URL: http://localhost:8080/ConfidentialBoardRoom) setting your name to 'Security Auditor'.
2. Open the 'Security Options' dialog (shield icon in the toolbar).
3. Examine the status of: End-to-End Encryption (E2EE), Lobby Mode, and Password.
4. If the E2EE toggle is available, enable it.
5. Take a screenshot of the open Security Options panel and save it to '/home/ga/security_options_screenshot.png'.
6. Create a text report at '/home/ga/security_audit.txt' with the following format:

JITSI MEET SECURITY AUDIT REPORT
=================================
Meeting Room: ConfidentialBoardRoom
Audit Date: [current date]
Auditor: Security Auditor

SECURITY FEATURES STATUS:
- End-to-End Encryption (E2EE): [Available/Not Available] | [Enabled/Disabled]
- Lobby Mode: [Enabled/Disabled]
- Password Protection: [Set/Not Set]

ACTIONS TAKEN:
- [Describe actions, e.g., 'Enabled E2EE']

RECOMMENDATIONS:
- [Your observations]
